title: Region pin renewal — customer communication sequences and operator checklist
body:
Purpose
This note captures a pragmatic set of customer-facing communication sequences, operator verification steps, and minimal audit evidence bundling guidance for region-pin renewals. Focus: tenants with existing region pins that are approaching expiry, auto-renew scenarios, and manual acceptance flows where legal/contract changes are required.

Audience
- Customer success and account teams preparing renewal comms
- Operators/SREs who must validate and capture residency evidence during renewal windows
- Legal/Contracts for sign-off language and acceptance criteria

Scope and assumptions
- Applies only to tenants using explicit region pins (hard and soft pins).
- Renewal here means the process to re-assert, change, or remove an existing pin at or before expiration.
- We assume telemetry exists tagging requests/objects with tenant_pin_id, region_assertion_ts, and evidence_blob_id. If not, operator steps include how to surface missing telemetry.

High-level renewal patterns (decision matrix)
1) Auto-renew (customer previously opted-in to auto-renew): send reminder sequence + final receipt; operator only verifies evidence capture post-renew.
2) Manual confirmation required (contract or data policy changed): CS sends request -> customer acknowledges -> legal accepts -> operator verifies -> pin renewed.
3) Expiry without response: apply configured fallback policy (soft-unpin, reroute to nearest region, or hold requests) — CS notified, ops prepare rollback.

Timing and triggers (recommended cadence)
- 60 days before expiry: informational heads-up to account owner (tone: FYI, action optional).
- 30 days before expiry: action required notice with next steps and acceptance link (if manual).
- 14 days before expiry: escalation to primary contact and AM; include consequences (e.g., provider fallback behavior).
- 3 days before expiry: final notice + temporary protective measures (e.g., reduced retention windows while awaiting confirmation).
- On expiry: final state transition + automatic evidence capture and audit package creation.

Templates (use these as plain text snippets for emails & portal prompts)
1) 60-day informational (subject line)
Subject: Upcoming region pin review for your account
Body: Hi <Account Owner>, we wanted to share a heads-up that your tenant region pin (region: <REGION>, pin id: <PIN_ID>) is scheduled to come up for review on <EXPIRY_DATE>. No action required now — we’ll follow up with next steps if manual confirmation is needed. Contact <CS_REP> for questions.

2) 30-day action required (subject line)
Subject: Action required — confirm region pin for compliance and SLA continuity
Body: Hi <Name>, your account’s region pin for <REGION> must be reconfirmed by <EXPIRY_DATE> to maintain SLA-backed residency guarantees. Options: (A) Confirm same pin via acceptance link (recommended). (B) Request a change — reply with desired region and legal point of contact. If we don’t receive a confirmation, fallback routing will apply per your agreement. See attached acceptance checklist.

3) Final notice & consequences (3 days)
Subject: Final notice — region pin expires in 3 days
Body: This is the final reminder. If we don’t receive confirmation, we will transition to the configured fallback on <EXPIRY_DATE> at <HH:MM UTC>. This may affect data residency guarantees and your audit evidence package. Please contact <CS_REP> immediately.

4) Post-renewal receipt (automated)
Subject: Region pin renewal confirmed — <PIN_ID>
Body: Thank you — we confirmed renewal/acceptance for pin <PIN_ID> (region: <REGION>). Audit package ID: <EVIDENCE_ID>. You can download the evidence bundle from the portal or request it via support.

Operator verification checklist (quick-run during renewal window)
- Step 0: Ensure you have the tenant id and pin id from the renewal event.
- Step 1: Validate telemetry: query residency-tags where tenant_id=<TENANT> and pin_id=<PIN_ID> for the last 90 days. Confirm region_assertion_ts and consistency of request routing.
- Step 2: Evidence bundle composition: collect config snapshot (pin metadata, pin status change record), request routing logs (sampled 24–72 hours), KMS key location metadata (if customer provided dedicated key), and signed acceptance artifact (CS email or portal click record).
- Step 3: Hash and store bundle: compute SHA256 over the zip; add timestamp and storage location pointer (e.g., archived_evidence://<BUCKET>/renewals/<TENANT>/<PIN_ID>/<EVIDENCE_ID>).
- Step 4: Attach evidence id to tenant record and send the confirmation email template with evidence id.
- Step 5: If telemetry gaps found, run mitigation: (a) attempt re-hydration of logs from archived traces; (b) if missing, notify CS/legal and mark evidence incomplete — do not attest until remedied.

Edge cases and operator scripts
- Customer requests region change during renewal window: treat as new onboarding => require new acceptance; record previous pin termination timestamp and include migration plan in bundle.
- Customer provides legal addendum after expiry: accept with post-hoc evidence capture. Tag evidence as "post-assertion" and flag for legal review.
- Missing KMS location metadata: capture request for key confirmation and place hold on renewal completion until confirmed.

Audit packaging minimal fields (for compliance):
- tenant_id
- pin_id, pin_region, pin_type (hard|soft), create_ts, expiry_ts, renew_ts
- CS acceptance artifact id (email thread id OR portal click id)
- evidence_blob_id (pointer to archived evidence, hashed)
- routing-sample-ids (list of request ids used for sampling)
- operator id who ran verification, and timestamps

Portal flow notes (for UX/product)
- Acceptance CTA should show concise checklist: region, SLO implications, legal contact, KMS footprint.
- If customer opts into auto-renew during the flow, persist their choice and record the opt-in artifact in the evidence bundle.

Escalation and fallback behaviors (recommended defaults)
- Default fallback: soft-unpin + route to nearest compliant region for non-sensitive workloads.
- Conservative fallback (for regulated customers): hold requests and return 503 with descriptive message until manual intervention.
- Escalation path: CS -> Legal -> Engineering ops -> Head of Security (for 72+ hour unresolved renewals).

Communication quality guidance (tone and legal-safe phrasing)
- Avoid implying guaranteed outcomes outside contract language. Use: "To maintain your current region-bound SLA we require..." instead of absolutes like "we will lose compliance if..."
- Include clear timelines and single-point-of-contact. Attach the acceptance checklist as a single-page PDF to avoid ambiguity.

Operational runbook snippets (copy-paste for oncall)
- Verify renewal event (CLI): rpinctl show --tenant <TENANT> --pin <PIN_ID>
- Build evidence bundle (CLI): rpinctl evidence collect --tenant <TENANT> --pin <PIN_ID> --out /tmp/<EVIDENCE_ID>.zip && rpinctl evidence hash /tmp/<EVIDENCE_ID>.zip
- Upload and link: rpinctl evidence upload --file /tmp/<EVIDENCE_ID>.zip --tenant <TENANT> && rpinctl tenant attach-evidence --tenant <TENANT> --pin <PIN_ID> --evidence <EVIDENCE_ID>

Acceptance criteria for CS to close renewal loop
- Signed acceptance artifact present (portal click or signed doc).
- Evidence bundle built and hash stored in tenant record.
- Telemetry sampled and routed-confirmed for at least a 24-hour window post-renewal.
- No open legal items or KMS location uncertainties.

Open questions & proposed next steps
- Q: Should we enable automated evidence bundle generation in the portal for all renewal flows? Proposal: pilot for top 50 regulated customers.
- Q: How long should evidence bundles be retained for different regulatory regimes? Proposal: 7 years for EU/UK enterprise, 3 years for others; legal to confirm.

Owners and SLAs
- CS ownership: initial contact and follow-up cadence (owner: <CS_REP>)
- Operator ownership: evidence building and verification (owner: eng-ops oncall)
- Legal sign-off: acceptance language validation (owner: Legal - residency team)

Appendix: Example evidence email text (short)
Subject: Audit package ready — region pin renewal (id: <EVIDENCE_ID>)
Body: Hi <Name>, we built the audit package for your renewal (tenant: <TENANT>, pin: <PIN_ID>). Download link: <SIGNED_URL>. Hash: <SHA256>. Contact support if you need the package in a different format.

Notes: this doc is intended as an operational playbook and customer messaging kit. It should be kept minimal and iterated against actual renewal incidents. If you plan to use templates verbatim, run them past Legal for jurisdiction-specific phrasing.

Change log
- 2024-11-15: initial draft (Lena Rodriguez)
- 2024-12-12: added operator CLI snippets and telemetry sampling guidance (Marco Li)
- 2025-02-08: updated evidence retention proposal and escalation chain (Priya Singh)
